column1: # Isolates with R10.4.1 ONT, PacBio HiFi and Illumina reads of the same strain. Each reference was
# built from two independent HiFi assemblies (hifiasm and Flye; never picoasm), every site where the
# Illumina or HiFi reads disagree decided by a fixed rule and reviewed by hand. The HiFi column is
# empty on purpose: the references were assembled from those reads.
# - Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae (PRJNA1124925), ~5 Mb, one chromosome: a3842i5, a3857i10, m24, m10.
#   m24, m10 and a3857i10 carry a ~227 kb element between two copies of a direct repeat that is excised
#   as its own circle in 21-42% of the reads; the reference is the integrated form.
# - Helicobacter pylori DSM1 and DSM2452 (PRJNA1344618), 1.65 Mb chromosome + 10,031 bp high-copy
#   plasmid, two cultures each. Heavily methylated.
# xoo_a3842i5, xoo_a3857i10, hpyl_dsm2452_a and hpyl_dsm2452_b were held out from development.
